_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/test_total_mana_value_reduction.py. t_tmv_sum reduces by the TOTAL mana value of the artifacts you control; t_tmv_max is the identical card written with greatest_mana_value, the control that makes the sum-versus-maximum distinction measurable rather than argued. t_tmv_two and t_tmv_five are artifacts of mana value 2 and 5.

cards.name: Test Total Mana Value
cards.oracle_text:
This spell costs {X} less to cast, where X is the total mana value of artifacts you control.
Draw a card.

cards.name: Test Greatest Mana Value
cards.oracle_text:
This spell costs {X} less to cast, where X is the greatest mana value among artifacts you control.
Draw a card.
